name: G3
summary: Strong premium race/value frame with 50C clearance and an established performance-brand proposition.

frame.construction: Internally routed UDH carbon gravel chassis with a T47 shell, aero carbon seatpost and integrated carbon cockpit
frame.stiffness_evidence: A three-month exact-platform owner review reports a solid rough-terrain feel and good power transfer; this is qualitative ride evidence, not a measured stiffness result
